messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — starting intake for Compass-3B (3B decoder) for the hosted catalog. Thinking: smoke quant runs + perf/eval pass this week. Quick sync?

sam: Yep. Prioritize latency-sensitive routes (chat streaming / low-lat). Also need settling on target quant configs.

lee: +1. We should also prepare safety/regression prompt sets early. I'll ping platform for a temporary GPU slot.

maria: From HF notes: model weights ~6.4GB fp16 (rough check). Plan: try q4_0, q4_1, and q8_0 PTQ. cc @audrey for quant infra.

audrey: I can run our quant pipeline. I need weights in s3://redwood-private/models/compass-3b/v0 and a manifest. ETA 48h for initial q4_0/q4_1 pass.

deploy-bot: Deploy tracker created: https://deploys.redwood.dev/compass-3b/1779501234

sam: Proposed triage checklist (short):
- Smoke gen: 50 diverse prompts (chat/context lengths 32/512)
- Perf: P50/P95/P99 latency targets (P99 <= 250ms on rtx-a10 equiv)
- Quality: run small eval suite (MMLU subset + BBH smoke)
- Regression gate: delta <= 2% vs baseline on core metrics
If fail, fallback plan: fp16 canary -> investigate quant profile.

nina: Catalog entry stub (drop into /docs/models/catalog):
```yaml
model_name: compass-3b
version: v0
family: decoder
params: "~3B"
format: hf/transformers
recommended_quant: q4_1
supported_routes: ["chat", "text_generation", "embeddings (limited)"]
notes: "Initial intake: smoke quant + perf. DO NOT promote without QA signoff."
```

lee: Announcement plan draft: PR to docs/models, short blurb in #product, and optional beta list for early customers. Can we target a canary next Tue if all green?

maria: I'll take the catalog writeup + evaluation notebook. Sam — can you own perf jobs and uploading artifacts to the deploy tracker?

sam: Yep. I'll run perf harness and attach CSVs + flamegraphs. Also running the microbench script: 
```bash
python infra/bench/run_perf.py --model s3://redwood-private/models/compass-3b/v0 --batch 1 --seq 512 --out artifacts/compass3b_perf.csv
```

audrey: Quant run command (internal):
```bash
python infra/quant/convert.py --src s3://redwood-private/models/compass-3b/v0 --dst s3://redwood-private/models/compass-3b/q4_1 --mode q4_1 --manifest manifest.json
```
I'll post artifacts when done.

nina: Operational notes: if we see >3% regression on the LM eval suite or safety flags increase, abort canary and open a model-regression ticket. Otherwise proceed with canary + gradual rollout policy and add to catalog. :rocket:

sam: :thumbsup:

lee: tagging this thread as the intake tracker. Please drop artifacts and short summary once each step completes.

maria: I'll open the docs PR today and drop the eval notebook link in the tracker.

audrey: Starting quant run now. Will update in thread with artifacts and raw latency numbers.

nina: Thanks all — syncing again after initial perf + q4_1 smoke.
